metadata.description: HTML mockups for agents: a canvas that groups, names, tags, frames and captures app screens, with the product's tokens wired through a live tokens section and contrast audit.

plugins.name: mockups
plugins.description: Three skills on one canvas engine: mobile-mockups (iOS and Android phone frames), desktop-mockups (macOS and Windows windows and menu-bar panels), and store-screenshots (mockup screens placed on App Store, Play and Mac App Store canvases, exported at exact sizes).
